name: Rhode Island
summary: A white field with a gold anchor encircled by thirteen gold stars, above a blue ribbon reading 'HOPE'. The anchor has been Rhode Island's symbol since 1647.
origin: The anchor and the word 'Hope' appear on the colony's seal from 1647, probably inspired by the biblical phrase 'hope we have as an anchor of the soul' (Hebrews 6:19). The flag was adopted in 1897.

symbols.name: Anchor
symbols.meaning: Hope, from Hebrews 6:19; also Rhode Island's maritime life.

symbols.name: Thirteen stars
symbols.meaning: The original thirteen colonies; Rhode Island was the 13th to ratify the Constitution.

facts: Rhode Island was the last of the original thirteen states to ratify the Constitution, in 1790.
The flag's design reflects Rhode Island's Revolutionary War regimental flags.
clues: A gold anchor ringed by thirteen stars on white, above the word 'HOPE'.
Its motto is a single word.
Its anchor comes from a biblical verse about hope.
